description: This file defines a Spring AOP advice class 'AuthorizationAdvice' that enforces authorization policies before service layer methods are executed. It checks user privileges and roles, and throws exceptions if authorization fails.

classes.name: AuthorizationAdvice
classes.description: Provides an AOP advice that performs authorization checks before service methods are invoked.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Implements the advice logic to check user privileges based on method annotations and context state.

methods.name: throwUnauthorized
methods.description: Throws an exception with a message indicating authorization failure, customized for different privilege scenarios.
